contract.where: phewsh — the copy on this device (github.com/cleverideaz/phewsh)
contract.reads: Files in this project, including its .intent/.
contract.writes: May create or change files in this project. Nothing outside it.
contract.cost: Unknown — the engine reports which account authorizes a tool, never a price.
contract.authority: Runs on this machine, in this project only. No cloud, no other repository, no other device.
contract.verificationCeiling: Not verified. A receipt records what happened and points at evidence; it does not check the work.
contract.undo: File changes are yours to revert with git. Nothing reaches Record or Next unless you accept it.

checks.reason: Checks did not run. The engine dispatched a tool; it did not test the result.

cost.reason: Unknown — the engine observes which account authorizes a tool, never a price.

evidence.note: Inspect the changed paths with git in the project itself.

verificationCeiling: Not verified. This records that a run happened and what changed; it does not check the work.
unknowns: Whether the work is correct. No check ran here.
What the tool did internally — only its changed paths and output size were observed.
carried: The changed paths, the route that ran, and when.
The authority contract as it was reviewed.
The receipt id, so this run can be found again.
notCarried: The transcript and the model’s reasoning.
File contents and any secret in the environment.
Any judgement about whether the work is correct.
Protection from being altered. This is an ordinary file on your disk; Phewsh never rewrites it and checks its hash on read, but a program running as you could edit it.
